title: America to Aminjikarai
desc: An ambitious girl living in the USA falls in love with a man. However, when she confesses her feelings to him, she is surprised to find out that he is married.

title: Monster
desc: Anjanam, who respects all life forms, faces trouble after a rat creates havoc in his house. While he tries to get rid of the rodent, a criminal breaks into his home to find his missing diamonds.

title: Amma Kanakku
desc: Shanti works as a maid in several homes to give her daughter, Abhinaya, a good life. However, when Abhinaya remains lax in her studies, Shanti decides to join her school to motivate her.

title: Dhamaka
desc: Things get complicated when Swami and Anand, two look-alike men from different backgrounds, fall in love with the same girl.

title: Dasara
desc: In a town that is dependent on coal mining, the lives of three childhood friends turn chaotic when they get into a fight with the son of the village headman.

title: Madhagaja
desc: The wife of one of two rival dons sends her son to a distant land to shield him from their relentless feud. However, the son, raised as an orphan, eventually returns to the brutal world of violence.

title: Sathuranga Vettai
desc: A cunning fraudster profits from deceiving numerous victims. However, trouble ensues when a criminal group seeks revenge against his betrayal.
